items.title: Apple fails to impress Wall Street, bear market chatter heats up, and AI assessing job productivity
items.summary:
Market Hang's panel discusses Apple's (AAPL) stock and how memory prices are affecting the company's bottom line.  Plus, how the midterms factor into a bear market outlook, and whether AI is doing "dirty work" at the office and assessing job productivity.

Today's panel includes Tema ETFs Chief Investment Strategist Paisley Nardini, Aptus Capital Advisors Head of Equity & Portfolio Manager David Wagner, Business Insider Today Executive Editor & Anchor Dan DeFrancesco, Barron’s Tech Reporter Nate Wolf, and Wall Street Veteran & “The Buy Side” Author Turney Duff.

items.title: What does it mean for the AI trade that Apple is the priciest 'Mag 7' stock?
items.summary:
Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on whether Apple is getting too expensive at about 36 times forward earnings and what signals lie beneath it about the AI trade's staying power.

Today's panel includes Paisley Nardini, Chief Investment Strategist at Tema ETFs; David Wagner, Head of Equity and Portfolio Manager at Aptus Capital Advisors; Dan DeFrancesco, Executive Editor and anchor of Business Insider Today; and Barron's reporter Nate Wolf.

items.title: Mid-term facts & refrigerator hacks, tech sell-off continues, Binance CEO addresses issues
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the top stories of the trading day, including the reasons Palantir (PLTR) isn't escaping the AI rout, why Disney (DIS) is poised to cut jobs, and how Apple's (AAPL) earnings just turned into a dull day for John Ternus and company.

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Binance (BNB-USD) CEO and Founder, Changpeng Zhao, to examine the roughly $6.3 billion worth of digital assets drained from Binance on Oct. 29 due to a hack.

items.title: What is holding Apple's stock back despite an impressive Q4?
items.summary:
Despite topping fiscal fourth quarter earnings estimates and outpacing iPhone sales forecasts, Apple's (AAPL) strong performance has seemingly failed to move the needle on the stock.

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi assesses Apple's latest quarter, naming concerns tied to rising memory prices.

items.title: Stocks continue sell-off as AI worries mount, Wall Street braces for midterms, Palantir outlook
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Pras Subramanian, Jake Conley, and Sherwood News Head of Markets Luke Kawa tackle the day's top stories, including Palantir's (PLTR) outlook signaling a slowdown in AI-fueled sales growth, Disney (DIS) looking to cut jobs in a cost-saving push, and how Wall St. is bracing for changes in Congress from the midterms.
